uncertainties, observations and unresolved sources still limit scientific use.
• Verify source identity, dated measurements, required uncertainty and compatible solutions.
• Use fitted natural/human-technology/artifact comparisons and withheld observations before physical-origin
• Independent population calibration and search-wide error control are required before significance claims.
• Binding/replay verifies consistency, not source authenticity or measurement accuracy.
• No natural/artificial origin, calibrated probability or five-sigma result is supplied.
• Complete local enrichment and scientific operation readiness remain separate requirements.
Discovery day: not available; not inferred from observations or local intake.
No verified ledger receipt history supplied in this view; source timestamps are not a substitute.
UTC receipts may display Z instead of +00:00; original literals and complete meanings remain in JSON.
Source labels, local receipts and dynamical epochs are different roles; no common UTC time axis is inferred.
Consistency/replay does not authenticate sources, verify clock synchronization or establish scientific readiness.
Adapter read time; not an observation.
Rank is an uncalibrated follow-up heuristic, not Gaussian significance or an origin probability. Not flagged does not
mean natural. Impact risk is not assessed here. Legacy unverified rows are retained, not promoted to measured evidence.
